description: Header file defining classes and enums for network connectivity management, including endpoint caching, connectivity testing, and monitoring within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: EndpointManager
classes.description: Manages saving and loading network endpoints to/from a cache file.

classes.name: TestConnectivity
classes.description: Performs connectivity tests to determine internet and captive portal status.

classes.name: ConnectivityMonitor
classes.description: Monitors network connectivity status and manages connectivity checks.

methods.name: writeEndpointsToFile
methods.description: Writes endpoints to cache file.

methods.name: readEndpointsFromFile
methods.description: Reads endpoints from cache file.

methods.name: setConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Sets endpoints for connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: getConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves endpoints used for connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Returns current connectivity monitor endpoints.

methods.name: TestConnectivity
methods.description: Constructor for connectivity testing with endpoints and parameters.

methods.name: getCaptivePortal
methods.description: Returns URI of captive portal detected.

methods.name: getInternetState
methods.description: Returns current internet connectivity status.

methods.name: getCurlError
methods.description: Returns last curl error code.

methods.name: checkCurlResponse
methods.description: Checks curl response for connectivity status.

methods.name: checkInternetStateFromResponseCode
methods.description: Determines internet state from response codes.

methods.name: curlSetOpt
methods.description: Sets curl options with error handling.

methods.name: ConnectivityMonitor
methods.description: Constructor for network connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: stopConnectivityMonitor
methods.description: Stops the connectivity monitor thread.

methods.name: startConnectivityMonitor
methods.description: Starts the connectivity monitor thread.

methods.name: switchToInitialCheck
methods.description: Switches to initial connectivity check.

methods.name: setConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Sets endpoints for the monitor.

methods.name: getConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Gets current endpoints for the monitor.

methods.name: getInternetState
methods.description: Retrieves current internet state and interface info.

methods.name: getCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Returns URI of detected captive portal.

methods.name: connectivityMonitorFunction
methods.description: Main thread function for connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: notifyInternetStatusChangedEvent
methods.description: Notifies system of internet status change.
